name: inhibitor of nuclear factor kappa B kinase subunit epsilon
pathways: positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction

function.text: IKBKE encodes inhibitor of nuclear factor kappa-B kinase subunit epsilon. Annotated molecular activities include IkappaB kinase activity and protein serine kinase activity. It participates in positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and immune response.

germline.text: The reviewed GenCC assertions do not establish a conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship for this draft; limited or conflicting assertions require separate review.

somatic.text: IKBKE amplification and overexpression have been described in breast carcinoma; these findings should not be equated with the effect of every sequence variant.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Gene-specific alteration context described by NCBI/RefSeq; variant applicability requires review.
